title: Annual report.
bodyText: The attorney general shall submit an annual report to the United States Department of Justice with regard to the information provided in section 480B-2.
bodyHtml: [§480B-3]  Annual report.  The attorney general shall submit an annual report to the United States Department of Justice with regard to the information provided in section 480B-2. [L 1995, c 243, pt of §2]
